---
title: "Suggestion box"
listing:
  contents:
    - "**/*.qmd"
    - "**/*.md"
    - issues.yml
  type: table
  fields: [title, description]
  field-display-names:
    title: "Topic"
    description: "Question"
  sort: "title"
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: true
  table-hover: true
---

Topics that someone thinks the council should discuss and write about. Any topic on this list can become a best practice, a guideline, or a post.

[Suggest a topic](https://github.com/cheac-ai/cheac-ai.github.io/issues/new?template=topic-suggestion.yml){.btn .btn-outline-dark .btn-sm}

Suggestions open as a short form on GitHub (a free GitHub account is needed) and appear on this list shortly after.

To work on a topic, open its page, expand it, and move it to the section where it belongs (see [Contributing](../contributing/contributing.qmd)).
